This is the Food Line Dispatch for June 5, 2026.

Today’s briefing tracks source-backed food insecurity signals across U.S. states and local systems.

Edition status: Daily edition.

Lead pressure point: SNAP benefits delayed and an application backlog is affecting households.

United States, US: National food security context and trend information. Source: USDA ERS.

Seattle, WA, WA: Food bank demand increased, pantry lines grew, and the provider reduced hours due to low inventory. Source: Food Lifeline.

Dallas, TX, TX: Food pantry demand increased and the organization reported reduced distribution because of low inventory. Source: North Texas Food Bank.

New York City, NY, NY: Demand increased, pantry lines lengthened, and emergency food distribution expanded. Source: City Harvest.

Oregon, OR: SNAP benefits delayed and an application backlog is affecting households. Source: Oregon Department of Human Services.

United States, US: Summer meal site closure and SUN Bucks delay are leaving children missing meals. Source: USDA FNS.

For full sourcing and map notes, read the dispatch and source table at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
